status: accepted bounded instruction checkpoint; original PHPStan parity goal remains open
contract:
# Trait receiver scope proof for declared property reads

Outcome: reuse the existing declared-property cache for nonpublic accesses in instance trait methods whose canonical lexical scope follows from their immutable hidden receiver class. No recognizer or new PHP semantics.

Baseline: clean ef167a36; runtime SHA acf6cc87b7952494bc83207f31a50d9b9da580b81130502183d58b0df750d500. Accepted correctness-only PGO SHA e92b160a2e533d7152866d0330aafa4d84e7863163899aeb1f1708b14d15b280, analysis median 73.4883G. Early comparison uses exact metadata-only test-fast SHA e79368453e7cecca6b80c02938017ce02ae2dceda64355071f391f61bbd83366.

Evidence: preceding accepted PGO analysis slow property reads: 584,894 calls and 2.2281G inclusive instructions, nested helper costs overlap. The private current-runtime whole-command diagnostic has 636,863 slow reads; 340,536 are accessible nonpublic slots without hooks and without fixed function or closure scope. 228,180 repeat in one generic trait equality body. That body resolves scope from its receiver but the existing cache publication requires a fixed function or closure id. Whole-command counters include startup and are not weighted phase costs.

Hypothesis: preserve the canonical trait receiver class as a compact cache proof, alongside existing function and closure proofs. A constant-name cache hit validates both the property receiver class and the executing trait receiver class. Op-array identity fixes the trait body; class metadata is immutable within one executor. A changed receiver or rebound closure misses before storage access.

Envelope: instance trait scopes recovered canonically from CV0 only; hidden trait lexical-scope TMP and static trait scopes remain canonical. Read, reference-source and modification flags keep existing property semantics; hooks, undef/unset, readonly, lazy initialization, magic and exceptions retain exact existing handling. No new frame/value/cache size or unsafe block. The direct getter/JIT paths may remain conservative rather than admitting a new proof.

Ownership: sole integrating agent in codex/perf-phpstan-cold, execute.rs, instruction.rs, baseline_object_calls.rs and focused scoped-property tests. Existing ordinary write caches and compiler remain unchanged.

Gates: cache metadata roundtrip; exact PHP CLI differential for class alternation with identical target class but different lexical trait consumer, inherited/recomposed trait methods, rebound closures, readonly/array references, hidden lexical TMP and static fallback; existing scoped-property/trait/property-boundary tests, fmt and unsafe policy. Early native instruction filter >=0.5% on same five-file phase and exact output before fresh independent-input PGO. Final default/no-default/all relevant suites and all-target check; fresh PGO repeated phase, representative independent controls, RSS/code size, cleanup and sanitized evidence.

Stop: reject source or output drift, stale scope hits, callback/type/visibility ordering changes, any new hot allocation or unsafe invariant, or early saving below 0.5%. Do not stack compensating changes. Native evidence x86-64 only; no new architecture lowering. Parity remains open after any bounded improvement.

Measurement review: the initially retained exploratory baseline was an all-feature binary from a later Cargo gate, and failed before phase measurement. It is invalid and no counts are used. Rebuild the exact accepted lifecycle source snapshot with the same default test-fast flags before comparing; retain its fresh source/binary identity.

selection_diagnostic.scope: whole command, including startup; diagnostic instrumentation only
infrastructure_failures: The first diagnostic run used the phase PHAR without a control FIFO and stopped at analysis entry; those counters are startup-only and not used for selection.
The first ordinary-archive retry referenced a missing vendor archive and ran no diagnostic. The actual retained archive then completed and agreed with PHP.
Two resolution-instrumentation builds accessed a nonexistent function name field; both failed compilation. The corrected op-array name build completed.
selection_diagnostic.budget: Preceding accepted PGO analysis profile: 584894 slow reads and 2228100000 inclusive instructions; nested costs overlap. Whole-command diagnostic counters are neither phase counts nor weighted instruction costs.
